summary: Assess existing code for concrete maintainability and correctness risks without changing the implementation.

outcomes: Distinguish material code-quality risks from style preferences and harmless complexity.
Report each finding with evidence, consequence, confidence, and a proportionate response.

scenarios.title: Audit a difficult module
scenarios.prompt: Use the assess-code-quality skill to review this module for maintainability risks without changing any files.
scenarios.outcome: The review ranks only evidence-backed findings and preserves the read-only boundary.

scenarios.title: Reject a pattern-only complaint
scenarios.prompt: Use the assess-code-quality skill to decide whether this procedural implementation is bad because it does not use design patterns.
scenarios.outcome: The review evaluates concrete consequences and does not treat a missing pattern as a defect.
